Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the "Updated Understanding" section of its first turn. It hallucinated the identity of the performer associated with "Victim of Romance." While the search results (provided by WebSurfer) correctly identified Michelle Phillips as the artist, the Planner incorrectly stated that "Victim of Romance" is a song written by Moon Martin and first released by Michelle Phillips. In reality, the Wikipedia snippet visible in the search results explicitly states that "Victim of Romance" is Michelle Phillips' *solo album*, not a song written by Moon Martin (who wrote a different song of the same name). By misinterpreting the source material and conflating two different works with the same title, the Planner established false context before delegating the task, leading to a confidently wrong conclusion based on faulty premises.
